feedback:
Implementation review requires revision before approval. Preserve the accepted query input, business results, actual per-item page visits, workbook-writing operation and root cleanup; do not replace operations with literal results. The initial-state interpretation currently receives all extracted links and selector hints, although its decision needs control text and blockage evidence. Provide separate views per consumer using existing typed field bindings and loops, with independent extract only where necessary. Keep full observations and exact action references outside global interpretation and reconnect decisions through explicit existing bindings. Do not feed one superset to every consumer.
The reads currently cap whole HTML at 60000 characters, do not consume continuation, and merely pass truncated into interpretation. That does not establish complete observation. Use the inspected producer's bounded page-list/record contracts with existing foreach to consume the full snapshot before navigation; narrow reads if capture is incomplete, or fail explicitly through requires when completeness cannot be established. Truncation must never become an ABSENT row or a successful workbook. Do not invent ports or fields; inspect an exact contract if necessary. Keep global comparison/ranking global on necessary compact facts, preserve all items/order/grouping, and retain exact later action references. Do not add public inputs, defaults, new permissions or larger limits. This revision may add the required observation loops/views but must preserve unrelated business work and the accepted interface.
